VM=myvm OLD=1.2.3.4 NEW=5.6.7.8 GW=; R=$(virsh qemu-agent-command $VM "{\"execute\":\"guest-exec\",\"arguments\":{\"path\":\"/bin/sh\",\"arg\":[\"-s\",\"--\",\"$OLD\",\"$NEW\",\"$GW\"],\"capture-output\":true,\"input-data\":\"\"}}") && PID=$(echo "$R" | grep -o '"pid": *[0-9]*' | grep -o '[0-9]*$') && until R=$(virsh qemu-agent-command $VM "{\"execute\":\"guest-exec-status\",\"arguments\":{\"pid\":$PID}}"); echo "$R" | grep -q '"exited": *true'; do sleep 1; done; for k in out err; do echo "$R" | grep -o "\"$k-data\": *\"[^\"]*\"" | cut -d'"' -f4 | base64 -d; done
